content.text: Seven-second live-action historical tent scene, full-frame 16:9. Reference 1 locks the Pang Tong actor, crown, dark blue robe, seated pose and phoenix screen; reference 2 only locks the small 25 mm square brown-gray bronze private seal, low perforated knob and short dark red cord. Hold a fixed normal-lens medium close shot: his complete face and extended right palm stay visible together throughout. He looks directly toward the listener at the camera. His right palm moves forward slightly but does not hand over yet. His lips speak the one permitted sentence once, naturally, then close. Do not push into a hand macro, do not enlarge the seal. Neutral soft motivated side light, worn tactile materials, no supernatural effects. Room air and slight cloth rustle only under the permitted dialogue. No other voice, no music, no captions, no black bars. The only permitted spoken words are: 此乃我的私印，请你持此，速救主公。 Sound contract: absolutely no background music or score, including music generated inside the source clip. Preserve scene ambience, synchronized physical sound and appropriate natural human breathing or exertion. Spoken dialogue is limited to the explicitly permitted lines in this request. Do not read control instructions, labels or unrelated narration.
